answer_4.quote: We invited researchers at the ADAPT Research Centre (Ireland) to participate in our study via an email (see email template in Appendix A) to the centre-wide mailing list, linking to a sign-up form that asked for English language proficiency...
answer_4.guideline: The evaluator should check if each element in the input triples is verbalised. If any element is missing, it should be marked as an omission error. ... The evaluator should check if all content words and phrases in the verbalisation correspond to elements in the triples. If any content word or phrase does not match an element in the triples, it should be marked as an addition error. ... The evaluator should check for repeated content in the output, including close paraphrases.
